stem: How is the article “Forest Bathing” organized to develop the thesis?

options.label: A
options.text: By presenting a personal experience with forest bathing and reporting on studies that support the reasons for the effectiveness of that experience

options.label: B
options.text: By explaining why people, from participants to practice providers, support further research to confirm the importance of forest bathing

options.label: C
options.text: By providing the reader with step-by-step instructions on how to achieve the objectives of forest bathing

options.label: D
options.text: By describing how the practice of forest bathing began and has expanded to new areas in hopes that its results can be repeated and confirmed
